seo.title: Seene pricing — Free and Pro, no commission
seo.description: Calendar, clients and WhatsApp reminders are free. Pro helps you earn more and costs less than one visit a month. 0% commission on clients.

title: Simple pricing. No commission.
description: Everything that replaces your notebook is free. Pro helps you earn more and costs less than one visit a month.

free.title: Free
free.note: Say goodbye to your paper notebook
free.f4: Booking page with a “made with Seene” mark

pro.title: Pro
pro.noteKg: Less than half of one manicure

pro.f2: Money: expenses and net for the month

disclaimer: The Pro price is preliminary and will be set after testing with beauty pros.

payback.title: One returning client pays for a month of Pro.

trial.a: Yes, you can try Pro after signing up, no card needed. The first 20 beauty pros get Pro free forever.

cancel.a: In your App Store or Google Play settings, any time. No calls, no emails.

stop.q: What happens to my clients if I stop paying?
stop.a: Nothing is lost. Bookings and clients stay; only the Pro features turn off.

clients.q: Do clients pay anything to book?
clients.a: No. No fees for clients and no cut of your services.
